title: silene tenuis var. jenissea
intro: Silene tenuis var. jenissea, commonly known as Mountain Avens, is a plant species that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Avens include its ability to modulate the immune system, protect against oxidative damage, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
